name: EA Sports FC 27: Ultimate Edition
summary:
Ultimate Edition includes:
- 6,000 FC Points over 3 months
- FUT Player Evo slot
- 5 Manager Live Challenge Creation Slots
- 5-Star Senior Scout in Manager Career

Ultimate Edition pre-orders includes:
- Up to 7 days Early Access
- Season 1 Premium Pass
- FUT Player Dribbling Evo for FC 26
- Career Dynamic OVR Pre-season Boost

Ultimate Edition pre-orders by August 31st includes:
- FUT 85+ OVR International ICON Player Item (untradeable)
- FUT 93+ OVR ICON Player Pick (untradeable) for FC 26

Plus all Standard Edition, The Grounds and Career content.
